source: Car and General (Kenya) Plc consolidated audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 (Deloitte and Touche LLP, unmodified opinion dated 29 April 2026), consolidated statement of financial position, Shs thousands stored in absolute Kenya shillings: non-current assets 10,714,126; current assets 11,058,122; total assets 21,772,248; equity attributable to owners 7,992,222 plus non-controlling interests 267,512 equals total equity 8,259,734; current liabilities 10,325,910; total assets less current liabilities 11,446,338; cash and bank balances 792,629. CRON 20261117: FY2025 column written and FY2024 current assets and non-current assets corrected to the printed comparatives 10,447,092 and 8,529,919 (the stored 6,110,911 was the inventories line and 12,866,101 was total assets less that line). Total liabilities 13,512,514 and non-current liabilities 3,186,604 are not single printed subtotals: they are total assets less total equity, and that figure less current liabilities, and the second agrees with the printed components (deferred tax 1,059,532 plus borrowings 1,517,592 plus lease liabilities 442,672 plus loan due to shareholder 166,808). Identity: non-current plus current assets equals total assets and total liabilities plus total equity equals total assets, both exactly.
